core_idea: T Corp. Class 3 VDCU Staff Outis is a Damage Dealer — **Tremor — Chain** control. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 Tremor (max +2); Coin Power +1 per 5 Tremor (max +5).
playstyle_guide:
- **Tremor — Chain** — enemy loses **Clash Power** at high Tremor Potency on target.
- **Time Moratorium** — time the stored-damage pop with your Tremor stacks.
- **Guard: Borrowed Time - Microcavity** grants 4 **Borrowed Time at Turn End** at Combat Start — use the defense slot to prep buffs before your main attacks.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 Tremor (max +2).

**S1 — Prepare to Collect** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Delay until 6+ Tremor on target — that is when the damage condition activates.

**S2 — T Corp. Microcavity Module** (BP 3, CP +5, x3): rolls — low 3, high 18 (Extremely High).
- Delay until 6+ Tremor on target — that is when the damage condition activates.
- triggers Amplitude Conversion, converting the target's Tremor to this kit's subtype
- Peak output requires both conditions: Inflict 2 Tremor | [On Hit] If target has 10+ Tremor, consume 4 Tremor on target to apply +2 Tremor Count to both the target and self.

**S3 — T-3 Collector Mace Max Activation** (BP 5, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / Extremely High stacked).
- If target is in either Amplitude Conversion or Amplitude Entanglement states, deal +30% damage ; If target has Time Moratorium, deal +30% damage ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 Tremor on target (max 2) ; [On Use] If target has Bind, Clash Power +1 ; [Attack End] Lose Borrowed Time on self ; [Attack End] Gain Violent Collections (once per Encounter)
- **Coin Power** scales with **Tremor** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- **Coin Power** scales with **Tremor** (+1 per 5, max +5) — build stacks first.
- +1% per 1 Tremor Count consumed
- triggers Amplitude Conversion, converting the target's Tremor to this kit's subtype
- Inflict +2 Tremor Count; [On Hit] Consume up to 3 Tremor on target; - Gain +(Tremor consumed x 2) Tremor Count; - Inflict (Tremor consumed - 1) Bind next turn

Combat passive — **Golden Time - Microcavity**: Turn End: If this unit's HP is between 10% ~ 20%, instantly heal 80% of this unit's max HP, and recover from Stagger. (once per Encounter).
  - If this unit has Borrowed Time, its Skills gain Final Power +1.

Combat passive — **Expeditious Execution of Official Duties**: 1 ally with the fastest Speed deals +10% damage when attacking a Staggered target.

Defense skill — **Guard: Borrowed Time - Microcavity**: Clashable Guard.
  - [Combat Start] If this unit is not in a Borrowed Time state, gain 4 Borrowed Time at Turn End (once per turn).
  - [Clash Win] Apply +2 Tremor Count to both the target and self.
  - [Clash Lose] Gain +4 Tremor Count.
